decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (PL-15-13-03, PL-15-13-04, PL-15-13-05, PL-15-13-06. Received: 6th June 2016
PL-15-13-03A. Received: 25th June 2016) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the  side wall of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The extension hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 20 Haslemere Avenue, Hounslow, TW5 9UT.

Condition : 6 - Prior to the occupation of the development hereby permitted, the proposed front boundary wall as shown on plan number PL-15-13-03A received 25th June 2016 shall be fully erected and shall be permanently retained and not replaced or repaired with any other boundary treatment exceeding 600mm in height
description: Erection of part single storey side and part single storey rear extension to the house
